name: Johann von Minden
role: Brotherhood of Blackheads merchant and candidate-seat organiser

approval.notes: Candidate-seat support record only; pending Canon Keeper review and never a ninth launch-faction row.

brief.want: Make the city's merchant networks answer to civic interests instead of a castle or foreign war chest.
brief.fear: A failed bargain will close the harbour to his associates and expose local tradespeople to retaliation.
brief.contradiction: He speaks of city self-rule while treating people and routes as assets in a ledger.
brief.secret_or_withheld_fact: He promised different versions of one harbour arrangement to rival buyers to buy the Blackheads time.

voice.diction: Short proverbs about weight, tide, and credit; names the cost before the moral argument.

outcomes.summary: Johann's favourable harbour-contract hook records a Blackheads candidate event without changing the launch ledger.

source_notes.summary: P7-013 Wave A brief promoted into the P4-046 candidate-seat support corpus.
